arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this adult cartoon mermaid game sprite. Image 1 is the existing drawing; image 2 is its exact original, with diagnostic red/white skin stippling. The user's correction takes precedence over the prior rendering: Raise the head just enough that her whole smiling face is ABOVE the water, as requested, and turn the face toward the viewer into a shallow three-quarter angle so BOTH EYES are visible. Make her clearly happy with relaxed brows, lifted cheeks and a playful smile. Keep the long horizontal hair, hairband, trailing splash arcs and compact head-only swimming silhouette. No new shoulders, torso or arms. Retain her established adult identity, golden-blonde hair, turquoise hairband, tan skin and green swimwear/tail wherever already visible. Keep the current cel shading and clean dark outlines. Mood happy and playful, not sad or stoic. Keep source occlusions except the explicitly requested face adjustment. Output the whole sprite with generous padding on an actually transparent background. No checkerboard, labels, scenery, ground or extra anatomy.
